evidence.snippet: Create an eCheck payment through the QuickBooks Payments API using customer bank account and routing details for an ACH debit.
This MCP server provides complete QuickBooks Online API integration for Claude Code and other MCP-compatible clients.

decisions.reason: Multiple pages describe a documented QuickBooks Online/Payments REST API with resource-style endpoints (charges, estimates, accounts), so 'rest' is supported while 'none' contradicts the evidence.

evidence.snippet: You must register an app on the Intuit Developer Portal and complete a one-time, browser-based OAuth handshake.
Start building your Intuit-powered app today.

decisions.reason: Developers can self-register an app, obtain sandbox credentials, and build against the documented REST API today, matching both agents' 'ready' verdict.
